name: Unchained Monk Monk of the Darkened Hand
body:
Monks of the darkened hand learn to blend their martial arts with the power of the shadow plane. They learn to hide and strike and to move like a shadow in the dark.

Hidden Step (Ex)

The monk of the darkened hand learns techniques to hide among the shadows.

Beginning at 2nd level, they gain a bonus to their Stealth checks equal to 1/2 their class level while in areas of dim light or darkness.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 2nd level.

Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, the monk of the darkened hand cannot be caught flat-footed, even if the attacker is invisible. They still lose their Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A monk of the darkened hand with this ability can still lose their Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against them.

If the monk of the darkened hand already has uncanny dodge from a different class, they automatically gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 3rd level.

Shadow Split (Sp)

Beginning at 4th level, as a standard action a monk of the darkened hand can spend a point of ki to split off a part of their own shadow to cast silent image as a spell like ability. The DC for this spell-like ability is 10 + 1/2 the monk of the darkened hand’s class level + their Wisdom modifier and they use class level for the caster-level-dependent variables.

This ability replaces slow fall at 4th level for the monk or the ki power at 4th level for the unchained monk.

Hide in Plain Sight (Su)

At 6th level, a monk of the darkened hand can use the Stealth skill even while being observed as long as they are in an area of dim light or darker. They need not have cover to do so.

This ability replaces fast movement gained at 6th level.

Shadow Calling (Sp)

At 8th level, a monk of the darkened hand’s connection to the plane of shadow allows them to create creatures and effects out of the power of that plane. They can expend 2 ki points to cast shadow conjuration as a spell-like ability using their class level as the caster level and their Wisdom bonus to determine the DC. At 14th level, this becomes greater shadow conjuration.

This ability replaces the slow fall gained at 8th and 14th levels and the ki powers granted at 8th and 14th levels.

Shadow Step (Su)

At 9th level, a monk of the darkened hand can expend a point of ki to travel between shadows as if using the spell dimension door.

However, unlike that spell, the teleportation must begin and end in an area of dim light or darker. A monk of the darkened hand can travel up to 5 feet per class level per point of ki spent in this manner.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 9th level.

Defensive Roll (Ex)

At 10th level, the monk of the darkened hand can expend 3 ki points to attempt to avoid a lethal blow. This functions as the rogue’s advanced talent of the same name.

This ability replaces the ki power gained at 10th level.

Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 12th level, a monk of the darkened hand can no longer be flanked.

This defense denies a rogue the ability to sneak attack the monk of the darkened hand by flanking them, unless the attacker has at least four more rogue levels than the target has monk levels.

If a character already has uncanny dodge from another class, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum rogue level required to flank the character.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 12th level.

Shadow Blast (Sp)

At 14th level, the monk of the darkened hand learned to harness the power of the shadow plane to deal devastating effects against their enemies. They can spend 2 ki points to cast shadow evocation as a spell like ability, using their class level as their caster level and their Wisdom modifier for the DC. At 18th level, this increases to greater shadow evocation.

This ability replaces the ki power gained at 14th level and fast movement gained at 18th level.

Slippery Mind (Ex)

At 15th level, a monk of the darkened hand becomes yet more resilient to enchantment spells. This functions as the rogue’s advanced talent of the same name.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 15th level.

Shadow Self (Su)

At 20th level, the monk of the darkened hand gains DR 10/- and a +2 luck bonus on all saving throws while in an area of dim light or darker.

Additionally, all abilities use one fewer ki points when in an area of dim light or darker.

This ability replaces perfect self.
